survival.encounter.answer.title: Someone answers from the classroom
survival.encounter.answer.text: Someone behind the door says they saw the others leave. You can't see their face, so you ask from your side of the door.
survival.encounter.notices.title: Two evacuation notices
survival.encounter.notices.text: Two notices show different times. A student says they put one up and asks you to compare them.
survival.encounter.counter_trade.title: A trade at the desk
survival.encounter.counter_trade.text: There's a spare battery under the counter. The person watching it wants to trade it for water.
survival.encounter.reading_steps.title: Footsteps in the reading area
survival.encounter.reading_steps.text: Footsteps between the shelves suddenly stop. A reader thinks whoever made them is waiting for someone to speak.
survival.encounter.one_seat.title: One seat left in the lounge
survival.encounter.one_seat.text: The person waiting here won't go out alone. They ask for a drink before coming with you.
survival.encounter.wait_roommate.title: Who are we waiting for?
survival.encounter.wait_roommate.text: A resident agreed to meet their roommate here. They ask you to wait two more minutes with them.
survival.encounter.alternate_route.title: Another way through
survival.encounter.alternate_route.text: Someone points to a second door on the floor plan. You can check where that exit leads.
survival.encounter.changed_sign.title: Someone moved the sign
survival.encounter.changed_sign.text: The arrow on the wall points toward the old entrance. The one on the post points the other way. A student knows which was drawn last.
survival.encounter.occupied_class.title: An occupied classroom
survival.encounter.occupied_class.text: A small group is waiting in a classroom. One of them just came back from the front hall and can tell you what they saw.
survival.encounter.wall_knocks.title: Knocks through the wall
survival.encounter.wall_knocks.text: Identical knocks sound from opposite sides of the wall. The person beside you asks whether you want to get closer.
survival.encounter.check_in.title: Temporary check-in
survival.encounter.check_in.text: Someone carrying a list asks you to stop. They say they're counting people still in the building, but wear no badge.
survival.encounter.parcel.title: A parcel for the next person
survival.encounter.parcel.text: A person opens a supply box and produces a sealed ration. They need drinking water.
survival.encounter.other_side.title: On the other side
survival.encounter.other_side.text: There are footsteps outside. A student says the hall behind the classroom leads to another exit.
survival.encounter.unlit_corridor.title: A dark corridor
survival.encounter.unlit_corridor.text: Someone dropped a spare battery in the dark corridor. Shine a light so they can find it, and they offer to let you keep it.
survival.encounter.echo.title: A broadcast and its echo
survival.encounter.echo.text: The same plea comes from both ends of the room. On the second call, someone nearby turns to look at you.
survival.encounter.borrow_lamp.title: Can I borrow your light?
survival.encounter.borrow_lamp.text: A survivor saw a battery on the floor but won't cross the dark room to reach it. They ask you to light the path.
survival.encounter.closed_hall.title: A corridor is closed
survival.encounter.closed_hall.text: Fallen desks block the main hall. Someone says the discussion room leads around them to a second exit.
survival.encounter.one_bottle.title: One bottle between two people
survival.encounter.one_bottle.text: The drinking fountain is off. A student offers a sealed ration for one of your bottles.
survival.encounter.court_crossing.title: Across the court
survival.encounter.court_crossing.text: Someone found a way across the court to a side exit. They ask you to look across for movement first.
survival.encounter.whistle.title: Someone is still whistling
survival.encounter.whistle.text: Someone on the stands gives a short whistle and says they're waiting for a teammate. When you stop, they whistle again.
survival.encounter.door_cry.title: Help from behind the door
survival.encounter.door_cry.text: Someone behind the kitchen door calls a worker by name. You step nearer, but they stay out of sight.
survival.encounter.last_water.title: The last bottles
survival.encounter.last_water.text: There's one bottle left on the counter. The person holding it wants food in exchange.
survival.encounter.stranger_at_door.text: Someone by the door asks for a drink. They can walk after resting and offer to come with you.
survival.encounter.stay_behind.title: Who stays behind?
survival.encounter.stay_behind.text: Two residents agreed to meet in the lounge. The one still here wants to wait two more minutes.
survival.encounter.brief_allies.title: A temporary alliance
survival.encounter.brief_allies.text: Someone heading out to look for friends asks if you'll travel together for a while.
survival.encounter.different_accounts.te: Two residents point to different exits. One admits they never reached the door and only heard about it.
survival.encounter.knows_name.title: They know your name
survival.encounter.knows_name.text: Someone keeps calling the same name. You stop in the hall, but they don't turn to look at you.
survival.encounter.rest_place.title: A place to rest
survival.encounter.rest_place.text: A student is sheltering in the lounge. They can still walk but ask for water before leaving with anyone.
survival.encounter.appointment.title: Wait for the rendezvous
survival.encounter.appointment.text: Someone is waiting for a friend who hasn't arrived. They ask you to stay for two more minutes.
survival.encounter.missing_keeper.title: The keeper is gone
survival.encounter.missing_keeper.text: The person guarding the supplies is gone. A resident only saw which way they left and can point it out.
survival.encounter.lawn_guide.title: A guide on the Campus Green
survival.encounter.lawn_guide.text: Someone at the lawn claims to know which path is still open. You can compare where they point with the signs.
survival.encounter.lake_cry.title: The repeated cry by the lake
survival.encounter.lake_cry.text: An identical plea comes from two spots by the lake. Even the pauses match. You only see one figure on the shore.
survival.encounter.stormfront.title: The rain came down harder
survival.encounter.stormfront.text: Rain gets heavier and the path turns slick. A survivor ducks under a ledge to wait it out.
survival.encounter.road_allies.title: Company on the road
survival.encounter.road_allies.text: A student stops at the fork. They're heading your way and ask if you'll cross together.
survival.encounter.road_betrayal.title: Someone offers to carry supplies
survival.encounter.road_betrayal.text: Someone offers to travel with you if you let them carry a bottle. A bystander says they're usually the first to run when danger comes.
survival.encounter.false_departure.title: They seemed to leave
survival.encounter.false_departure.text: A figure turns the corner out of sight, but the same call keeps coming from where they had stood.
survival.exp.blackout: The streetlights go out. The campus has lost power.
survival.exp.outbreak: People across campus are being hurt. Look around before you move.
survival.exp.incident_text: A student stops to help someone and gets bitten. The person on the ground looks up and says “Come help” in the student's voice.
survival.exp.old_broadcast: Gather at the west bank of Success Lake. Reply if you can hear this.
survival.exp.final_broadcast: This is Xin Hall. The west bank assembly is canceled. Come to the first floor of Xin Hall.
survival.exp.rain_arrived: Rain intensifies. Walking outdoors is slower.
survival.exp.missing: You need {item} to make this trade.
survival.exp.need_light: You need a flashlight with at least 12% charge.
survival.intro.0.text: It's 17:38. Students are still coming and going. Thunder shakes the glass in the guardhouse.
survival.intro.1.text: A low rumble comes from Success Lake. Fog spills onto the path, and several students stop to look.
survival.intro.2.text: The streetlights flicker twice. Phones lose their signal. Everyone assumes it's the storm.
survival.intro.3.text: The campus speakers get halfway through a message: “If the power goes out, first…” A burst of static cuts off the rest.
survival.intro.4.text: At the gate you pass an emergency notice. If the power goes out and phones stop working, look for a refuge bearing the campus staff's mark.
survival.event.betrayal_dynamic: A companion ran off with the water they were carrying.
survival.fixture.side_exit: Take the other exit to campus
survival.read.room_detail: The room shows signs of recent use. Follow the walkable passages to check the exits and where sounds are coming from.
survival.choice.event_take_route: Follow them to the alternate route
survival.choice.event_invite: Invite them to travel with you
survival.choice.event_entrust: Trust them with water and travel together
survival.exp.voice.cooperate.0: I just saw someone leave from the other side.
survival.exp.voice.cooperate.1: Stay there for a moment. We can talk from here.
survival.exp.voice.bargain.0: What do you have with you? We can trade.
survival.exp.voice.bargain.1: Let's be clear. I can only share half of this.
survival.exp.voice.plead.0: Can anyone hear me? Come over here.
survival.exp.voice.plead.1: Wait a little longer. Please. I really need help.
survival.exp.check.helpful.0: You ask for a new detail. Their account matches the sound, direction, and traces nearby.
survival.exp.check.helpful.1: They point out a trace you missed and agree to wait while you check.
survival.exp.check.guarded.0: They pause and admit there was a part they couldn't see.
survival.exp.check.guarded.1: They answer your question and steer clear of talking about their own supplies.
survival.exp.check.panicked.0: They mix up the direction. After a moment to breathe, they can put the details in order.
survival.exp.check.panicked.1: Their voice is shaking. They try again, but look ready to change their mind.
survival.exp.check.selfish.0: When you ask about their side of the trade, they finally show the supplies they were hiding.
survival.exp.check.selfish.1: You compare the accounts. They keep suggesting ways to take the supplies first.
survival.exp.check.mimic.0: You ask about something that just happened. They repeat another person's line word for word.
survival.exp.check.mimic.1: You back away. They keep talking to where you were standing, with exactly the same pause.
survival.exp.result.lure: Up close you can see its face. It lunges, still repeating the call for help.
survival.exp.result.taken: As soon as you hand over the supplies, they walk away with them.
survival.exp.result.exchange_water: You give them one meal, and they hand over the promised water.
survival.exp.result.exchange_cell: A bottle of water buys a spare battery.
survival.exp.result.left_with_light: You light the path, and they leave from the far end while you wait.
survival.exp.result.light: You light the corridor, and they return with a spare battery.
survival.exp.result.shelter: They take the water and agree to walk with you.
survival.exp.result.share: You offer water first. They share a meal with you in return.
survival.exp.result.storm: You wait for a while, and the sudden downpour eases.
survival.exp.result.wait_empty: The agreed time passes with no one returning. You have to move on.
survival.exp.result.wait_help: Someone makes it to the meeting point, leaves you water and heads off.
survival.exp.result.route: You confirm a walkable passage. The exit on the other side is available now.
survival.exp.result.information: You write down what they can confirm before moving on.
survival.exp.result.custody: They join you and take charge of one bottle of water.
survival.exp.result.panicked: They cannot answer your question. After waiting, you realize they are only looking for a way out.
survival.ending.dynamic: {person} stays by the door and asks the newcomers to move quietly.
survival.exp.reply.paper.helpful: I read the time on the paper. Check it yourself.
survival.exp.reply.paper.guarded: I couldn't see part of it. Use your own judgment.
survival.exp.reply.paper.panicked: I got it wrong. Give me a moment to think.
survival.exp.reply.paper.selfish: I'm just making sure we agree how to split things.
survival.exp.reply.paper.mimic: Can anyone hear me? Come over here.
survival.exp.reply.sound.helpful: The sound just came from that side of the passage.
survival.exp.reply.sound.guarded: I couldn't see part of it. Use your own judgment.
survival.exp.reply.sound.panicked: I got it wrong. Give me a moment to think.
survival.exp.reply.sound.selfish: I'm just making sure we agree how to split things.
survival.exp.reply.sound.mimic: Can anyone hear me? Come over here.
survival.exp.reply.route.helpful: You can come to the corner and decide for yourself.
survival.exp.reply.route.guarded: I couldn't see part of it. Use your own judgment.
survival.exp.reply.route.panicked: I got it wrong. Give me a moment to think.
survival.exp.reply.route.selfish: I'm just making sure we agree how to split things.
survival.exp.reply.route.mimic: Can anyone hear me? Come over here.
survival.exp.reply.person.helpful: I can slow down and tell you what I saw again.
survival.exp.reply.person.guarded: I couldn't see part of it. Use your own judgment.
survival.exp.reply.person.panicked: I got it wrong. Give me a moment to think.
survival.exp.reply.person.selfish: I'm just making sure we agree how to split things.
survival.exp.reply.person.mimic: Can anyone hear me? Come over here.
survival.room_desc.general_2: Long windows light the rows of desks. One end of the corridor leads to a route you can check.
survival.room_desc.general_3: The notice area connects to group classrooms. The stairs block the view of the tables.
survival.room_desc.general_4: A central wall separates the service desk from Classroom 121. The front corridor serves both sides.
survival.room_desc.engineering_1: Rows in Classroom 101 face the front, while a separate teaching corridor leads around the building.
survival.room_desc.physics: A long demonstration bench faces the room. Between the partitions, you can compare sounds from both sides.
survival.room_desc.chemistry: Teaching benches and discussion tables occupy opposite sides of the corridor.
survival.room_desc.gym: Court lines mark the wooden floor. The center and the edge offer different paths.
survival.room_desc.dining_hall: Food counters face the dining area. Several aisles lead between the tables.
survival.room_desc.ren_hall: Large wooden tables, a red sofa and bookshelves divide the common room.
survival.room_desc.shi_hall: The shared counters line the back. White and wooden tables form different routes.
survival.room_desc.li_hall: The parcel desk sits near the entrance. Wide windows, dark sofas and low shelves shape the lounge.
survival.room_desc.yi_hall: Past the service desk, large corner windows line the common room and its seating.
survival.exp.log_empty: Incidents you investigate or hear about appear here.
survival.route.wait: The gate notice mentions emergency refuges. Check nearby buildings for water or a flashlight while you wait.
survival.route.manifest.goal: Find the duty log at {place} and look for an evacuation route.
survival.route.echo_log.goal: At {place}, compare the recordings and identify the false announcement.
survival.route.lock_log.goal: Check the sign-in sheet at {place} for anyone who made it out.
survival.route.sealed.goal: Find the marked door at {place} and check whether anyone is still inside.
survival.route.manifest.text: A staff member left a note after the outage. “I only told people to take cover. Someone else used my voice to tell them to go inside.” Both recordings are at {place}.
survival.route.echo_log.text: The voice matches, but the instructions are opposite. The second message sends people inside. A note beside the recorder points to {place}, where you can check who entered.
survival.route.lock_log.text: People signed in, but nobody signed out. The last staff note says, “Someone is still knocking. I marked the door at {place}.” There may also be a spare battery in the desk.
survival.route.sealed.text: You find the staff member's mark. Someone knocks from inside and says the door won't open. The handle still works from your side. Stay in the hall or step inside to find them.
survival.route.outbreak: The outbreak has begun! Check the map for how to play. Press M to open it.
survival.fixture.echo_log: Compare voices on the portable recorder
survival.fixture.sample_audio: Listen to the library audio sample
survival.read.class_notice: It is an ordinary classroom notice with today's class schedule.
survival.read.sample_audio: The player is set to the library audio tour. People have been talking quietly nearby.
survival.read.common_radio: There is a handwritten equipment label on the intercom and no check-in notice beside it.
survival.read.lawn: This is the regular notice board. Rain has wrinkled the posters. An arrow still points to the academic buildings.
survival.clue.lawn.title: Campus Green notice
survival.clue.lawn.text: The board lists ordinary campus activities.
survival.clue.manifest.title: Temporary evacuation roster
survival.clue.manifest.text: The duty worker did not tell people to go inside. They left two recordings to compare.
survival.clue.echo_log.title: The repeated distress call
survival.clue.echo_log.text: The second recording stole the worker's voice. Find out what happened to those who followed it.
survival.clue.lock_log.title: No departures recorded
survival.clue.lock_log.text: Nobody signed out. The staff member marked a door where they still heard knocking.
survival.clue.sealed.title: Entrance to the refuge
survival.clue.sealed.text: Someone behind the marked door said the handle wouldn't turn.
survival.ending.title: Bad ending · The last name on the list
survival.ending.text: {name} reaches for the handle in the dark. It won't turn. The knocking has stopped, but the speaker carries your voice down the hall. Someone outside follows it. Your name is now on the last line of the register. The exit column is still blank.
survival.ending.arrival: “Is anyone still here?” The door locks behind you before anyone answers.
survival.ending.echo: The corridor speaker asks in your voice, “Is anyone still here?”
survival.ending.with_team: {person} pulls at the door. Footsteps approach outside, and neither of you can warn them to stop.
survival.ending.solo: Someone stops at the door and asks the same question you just did.
survival.room_desc.admin_hall: The service desk and performance foyer have separate paths. A duty log remains on the table by the service area.
survival.room_desc.engineering_2: Benches and a demonstration desk lead to a long classroom corridor with openings at both ends.
survival.room_desc.computer_science: The lobby display is flanked by study furniture. A path between the seats leads toward the archive.
survival.room_desc.student_center: Food kiosks and tables fill the left wing. A convenience store and service counters occupy the other side.
survival.room_desc.humanities_building: The lobby display and library desks occupy different sides. A passage continues behind the low shelves.
survival.encounter.shift_register.title: A missing page in the duty log
survival.encounter.shift_register.text: Someone says a name on the shift register was just added. They ask you to compare the time and handwriting.
survival.encounter.queue_for_help.title: Last person in the queue
survival.encounter.queue_for_help.text: A survivor has been waiting at the counter, but nobody came back. They ask how you got in before joining you.
survival.encounter.test_signal.title: A test bench still has power
survival.encounter.test_signal.text: Someone points out a battery under the display stand. They need a light to see if it rolled out of reach.
survival.encounter.two_doorways.title: Two voices at two doors
survival.encounter.two_doorways.text: You hear movement in both halls. Someone says the front hall is a dead end and the other leads to the side door.
survival.encounter.archived_voice.title: A voice in the archive
survival.encounter.archived_voice.text: A recording used to play at the exhibit. Now the same words come from behind a wall with no speaker.
survival.encounter.borrowed_keycard.text: A person holding a badge says they saw someone leave by the back. It belongs to somebody else. Do you trust them?
survival.encounter.ration_queue.title: Supplies after the crowd disperses
survival.encounter.ration_queue.text: The food line has dispersed. The person at the stall has a battery to trade for water.
survival.encounter.redacted_testimony.te: A line is missing from a written account. The person beside it saw the original and can clarify whether it was firsthand.
survival.encounter.library_refuge.title: Shelter beside the reading desks
survival.encounter.library_refuge.text: Someone hides behind a low reading-room shelf. They need water and will leave with you if you share a bottle.
survival.encounter.empty_food_court.text: A note on the table gives a meeting time. The survivor beside it wants two more minutes to see if anyone comes.
survival.location.trail_lawn: South Side of the Big Lawn
survival.encounter.blackboard_trace.text: A student asks you to check a room number written backwards on the board.
survival.encounter.return_cart.title: The Jammed Return Cart
survival.encounter.return_cart.text: Someone says a spare battery is trapped beneath the return cart and asks for help moving a fallen partition.
survival.encounter.borrowed_blanket.text: A blanket is wedged under a dorm door. A person whispers that a coat was all they managed to grab.
survival.encounter.lit_projector.title: The Last Projector
survival.encounter.lit_projector.text: The projector cuts out. Someone in the classroom asks for light to find what they dropped.
survival.encounter.emergency_drawer.text: A fallen panel jams the supply drawer. The person beside it asks what you can see inside.
survival.encounter.bleacher_watch.title: The Bleacher Lookout
survival.encounter.bleacher_watch.text: A lookout under the bleachers saw someone pass an exit and wants a companion.
survival.encounter.pantry_latch.title: Food Behind the Cooler
survival.encounter.pantry_latch.text: A worker says there are unopened meals behind the cooler, but clearing a path will take time.
survival.encounter.double_knock.title: Two Short, One Long
survival.encounter.double_knock.text: Someone says the dorm signal is two short knocks and one long. The next room taps out the same rhythm.
survival.encounter.dead_intercom.title: The Failing Intercom
survival.encounter.dead_intercom.text: Someone wants to warn the people in the hallway. The failing intercom also broadcasts outside.
survival.encounter.forgotten_change.text: Half-counted change lies on a counter. The person guarding a meal box asks for water first.
survival.encounter.gate_runner.title: The Runner from the Gate
survival.encounter.gate_runner.text: Someone returns from the gate with mud on their sleeves and asks to cross the next bend together.
survival.encounter.lawn_marker.title: The White Cloth on the Lawn
survival.encounter.lawn_marker.text: Someone calls a cloth tied to the bench a safety marker but cannot say who left it.
survival.encounter.library_stairs.title: Water Beneath the Steps
survival.encounter.library_stairs.text: Bottled water is wedged beneath the library steps. The person beside it wonders if its owner will return.
survival.encounter.clock_radio.title: The Radio by the Clock
survival.encounter.clock_radio.text: Someone waits for a warning over the radio. The infected nearby could hear it too.
survival.encounter.bench_partner.title: Waiting by the Lake
survival.encounter.bench_partner.text: A person on the bench watches the far shore. They will come along if you can spare some water.
survival.encounter.puddled_bag.title: Lunch in the Puddle
survival.encounter.puddled_bag.text: Someone asks you to fetch a half-submerged lunch bag while they watch the path behind you.
survival.encounter.dormitory_cart.title: The Cart Outside the Dorms
survival.encounter.dormitory_cart.text: There is one spot left on the cart. Its owner offers to carry your water and travel with you.
survival.encounter.split_road.title: Footsteps at the Fork
survival.encounter.split_road.text: A survivor heard one group stop at the fork but could not see which way they turned.
survival.encounter.distant_signal.title: Three Calls in the Dark
survival.encounter.distant_signal.text: Someone wants to answer three calls in the distance and cannot tell who made them.
survival.encounter.service_case.title: A Case by the Engineering Path
survival.encounter.service_case.text: A student thinks a small case that fell behind the railing holds flashlight batteries.
survival.route.marked_map.goal: At {place}, check the hand-drawn evacuation map.
survival.route.marked_map.text: Two exits are crossed out and marked locked. The drawing directs you to the next check at {place}.
survival.route.arrival_times.text: Different people are entered one minute apart, all in the same hand. Check the next record at {place} to trace who wrote it.
survival.route.relay_tags.goal: At {place}, check the radio relay tags.
survival.route.relay_tags.text: The two contradictory messages went through the same radio. Someone left its transmission record at {place}.
survival.route.empty_case.goal: At {place}, check the empty first-aid case.
survival.route.empty_case.text: The only thing left inside is a warning: the call repeats, so do not open a door on sound alone. The note leaves another lead at {place}.
survival.route.torn_route.goal: At {place}, check the torn evacuation slip.
survival.route.torn_route.text: Together, the scraps say the entrance opens inward, but a staff member is needed to get out. The last record is at {place}.
survival.route.return_tally.text: The arrival count rises while the exit count stays at zero. The last entry points to {place}, which may have the final headcount.
survival.exp.result.recover: The supplies are intact. You put them in your inventory.
survival.exp.result.recover_taken: After you free the supplies, the other person takes them and leaves.
survival.exp.result.warning_quiet: You use a shorter signal and wait for confirmation. The survivor beside you gives you a bottle of water.
survival.exp.result.warning_loud: The warning goes out. Footsteps nearby start moving toward you.
survival.clue.marked_map.title: Hand-drawn evacuation map
survival.clue.arrival_times.title: Arrival timetable
survival.clue.arrival_times.text: The entries look like the work of one person.
survival.clue.relay_tags.title: Radio relay tags
survival.clue.relay_tags.text: Both announcements came through the same relay.
survival.clue.empty_case.title: Empty first-aid case
survival.clue.empty_case.text: Someone warned that the call for help sounded like a recording.
survival.clue.torn_route.title: Torn evacuation slip
survival.clue.torn_route.text: Anyone could enter. Leaving depended on someone opening the door.
survival.clue.return_tally.title: Headcount sheet
survival.exp.result.warning_unanswered: The warning goes out. You wait a moment and hear no answer.
survival.exp.mimic_nearby: The same call for help repeats around the corner.
survival.route.echo_log.choice: The second message copies the staff member's voice to lure people inside. To find out who entered, check the original record at {place} or the backup at {alternate}. Either will give you the next lead.
survival.route.marked: The next stop is marked in your journal.
survival.choice.story_backup_team: Check the backup with a companion
survival.encounter.service_latch.title: The Service Door Latch
survival.encounter.service_latch.text: Something hits the door from outside. A caretaker points out an inner latch that could hold the entrance.
survival.encounter.parts_radio.title: The Radio in the Tool Cabinet
survival.encounter.parts_radio.text: A working radio is stored in the cabinet. Leave it playing here and take the hall while the infected move toward it.
survival.encounter.folded_kit.title: One Ration Each
survival.encounter.folded_kit.text: A worker sets out water and boxed food. Pick one and leave the other for the next person.
survival.encounter.last_reader.title: The Reader Behind the Shelves
survival.encounter.last_reader.text: A reader hears footsteps near the entrance and asks you to get them outside. They offer their spare water.
survival.encounter.night_latch.title: The Loose Corridor Latch
survival.encounter.night_latch.text: A resident finds that the latch still works, but it won't hold for long. You can check it before closing it.
survival.encounter.tray_alarm.title: The Kitchen Timer
survival.encounter.tray_alarm.text: The kitchen timer still has power. Let it ring here to draw any infected passing the doorway away.
survival.encounter.injured_runner.title: The Runner Under the Stands
survival.encounter.injured_runner.text: A runner with a twisted ankle is afraid to leave alone. They ask you to walk out with them.
survival.encounter.study_kit.title: The Last Study-Room Rations
survival.encounter.study_kit.text: There is one drink and one packet of food left. A student wants to save whichever one you leave for others in the building.
survival.encounter.lawn_ringing_cart.tex: An alarm clock on a cart still works. Let it ring to draw infected toward the edge of the lawn.
survival.encounter.plaza_ration.title: The Ration Bags at the Plaza
survival.encounter.plaza_ration.text: A survivor has packed one bag of water and one of food. Take either and leave the other.
survival.encounter.shore_timer.title: The Timer at the Shore
survival.encounter.shore_timer.text: A working timer lies beside the stairs. Leave it under the bench to pull infected away from your path.
survival.encounter.south_cache_note.titl: Two Supplies on the South Path
survival.encounter.south_cache_note.text: A note says to take only one item. Inside are drinking water and a sealed ration.
survival.event.door_rattle: Something followed you to the door. Move away from it.
survival.event.door_breach: An infected has come through the door!
survival.event.escort_complete: You reached the outside together and received a bottle of water.
survival.choice.event_divert: Leave a sound to draw the infected
survival.exp.result.divert: The device stays where it is. Nearby infected will head toward it for a short time.
survival.exp.result.barred: The latch holds. For a short time, infected cannot follow through this entrance.
survival.exp.result.escort: They begin following you. Lead them through any usable exit to receive the water outside.
survival.exp.result.escort_complete: You reached the outside together. They left a bottle of water before going on.
survival.exp.result.kit_food: You took the food and left the water for the next person.
survival.exp.result.kit_water: You took the water and left the food for the next person.
survival.exp.inspect.mimic: You change the question. They repeat the same sentence and keep staring at where you were standing. You have time to back away.
survival.exp.inspect.selfish: They keep pushing you to hand things over first. You set clear terms and insist on seeing the supplies before going further.
survival.exp.inspect.divert: The device has power. You check which way to leave. Planning the exit gives you extra time to get clear.
survival.exp.inspect.barricade: The latch needs to be pushed all the way down. Set properly, this door will hold a little longer.
survival.exp.inspect.escort: They can walk, though slowly. Lead them outside and stop to wait if they fall behind.
survival.exp.inspect.kit: Both rations are sealed. Pick one and leave the other behind.
survival.exp.inspect.investigate: You watch from a safe distance before deciding whether to come closer.
survival.exp.inspect.verify: You compare the claim with the marks nearby and separate what they saw from what they only heard.
survival.exp.inspect.information: You ask them to point out what they saw and say whether it happened before or after the outage.
survival.exp.inspect.trade: You check what they are trading and agree on what you will hand over.
survival.exp.inspect.share: They need a drink. You check that their food is still sealed.
survival.exp.inspect.shelter: You make sure they can travel before deciding whether to offer water and let them come along.
survival.exp.inspect.wait: Waiting here costs two minutes compared with moving on now.
survival.exp.inspect.route: You compare the route with the map on the wall to see whether it leads to the other side.
survival.exp.inspect.light: You glance at the floor. Lending light takes battery power, so check what they are looking for first.
survival.exp.inspect.storm: The rain on the ledge grows louder. Waiting takes time and energy, but lets the worst pass.
survival.exp.inspect.invite: You agree on where to regroup if separated. There is room for at most two companions total.
survival.exp.inspect.custody: You confirm the offer is for one bottle. Once you hand it over, you no longer carry it.
survival.exp.inspect.recover: You check where the item is stuck. Working out how to reach it first saves time.
survival.exp.inspect.warning: You check who can hear you. A loud warning may also alert infected nearby.
survival.clue.storm.title: The storm before the outage
survival.clue.storm.text: Phones went down before the power. The gate notice says refuges have marked entrances.
survival.read.exhibit: Two backpacks sit under the display. A note says, “We left by the side door. If you find this, stay away from the speakers.”
survival.read.student: I got separated from two friends during the outage. They were waiting by the exhibit table. Could you check whether they're still there? Or we can leave together now.
survival.read.student_update: They left a note. They must have made it out through the side door. I can stop waiting and come with you.
survival.read.student_search: Check under the display table. If they left first, they will have left a note for me.
survival.read.clerk: I have a spare battery but no drinking water. Trade a bottle for the battery, or share a drink and I'll come along.
survival.read.stranger: I can come with you. If you trust me with the water, it goes in my bag.
survival.read.ask_stranger: “I ran when the infected came. I don't know what happened to the person who was with me.”
survival.read.bitten: The bite is deep. They breathe faster and struggle to finish a sentence. Decide whether to step away now or keep going together.
survival.read.joined: I'll follow you. If something is chasing us, look back before you go through a door.
survival.read.mimic: Someone calls you around the corner. When you stop, they say it again with exactly the same pauses.
survival.read.test_voice: You ask for their name. Instead of answering, they repeat, “Come help me.”
survival.encounter.notices.information: You compare timestamps. One notice went up during class; the other was posted after the outage.
survival.encounter.changed_sign.informat: The student shows you the newer mark on the post. You make a note of the direction.
survival.encounter.occupied_class.inform: The scout says the front hall is open, though several figures are standing at the bend.
survival.encounter.check_in.information: They explain the times on the list but cannot say who asked them to wait at the door.
survival.encounter.different_accounts.in: You question them separately. Only one actually reached the exit; the other heard it secondhand.
survival.encounter.missing_keeper.inform: They point out the direction, then admit they never saw the person make it outside.
survival.encounter.lawn_guide.informatio: The signs confirm the path leads to the academic area. Whether it's clear the whole way is still unknown.
survival.encounter.shift_register.inform: There are two kinds of handwriting. One person added the last several names.
survival.encounter.borrowed_keycard.info: They say they found the badge. Someone took the back door, but they didn't see where they went.
survival.encounter.redacted_testimony.in: The missing line was secondhand. The account only confirms that someone heard two orders after the outage.
survival.encounter.blackboard_trace.info: The door plate is normal; the board was deliberately written backward. You note it as a marker for this room.
survival.encounter.double_knock.informat: The rhythm matches, but it came from the wrong room. Knocking can be copied, too.
survival.encounter.lawn_marker.informati: They saw the cloth but never saw who tied it. Treat it as an unverified marker.
survival.encounter.split_road.informatio: They can confirm the footsteps stopped at the fork. They cannot tell you which road is safe.
